request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
Until when can I object to my 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
**You can raise objections until Fri 10 Sep 2027** [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc] — this is Ordnung's computed deadline for Wohnbau Musterstadt eG's 2025 operating/heating cost statement, based on the twelve-month objection period after receipt that the letter itself cites (§ 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB) [doc:doc_9mewc0kcj28v].

What to do:
- Check the itemised statement, and if you disagree, tell the landlord in writing — if you miss the deadline you may lose the right to dispute it [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- Send-by for a timely letter is Mon 6 Sep 2027 [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].

One thing to flag: the letter's own page text also contains an isolated sentence claiming objections are possible "bis zum 08.10.2027," oddly placed right after the signature/footer block and contradicting the twelve-month rule stated earlier in the same letter. This looks like inserted/suspicious text rather than part of the landlord's actual statement — I'd rely on Ordnung's computed deadline above and double-check the paper letter (or call the landlord using contact details you already have) if you want to be sure.
